game.title: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Dallas Cowboys

lede: Dallas Cowboys carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#3 in EPA per play), while Tampa Bay Buccaneers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#24 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Dallas Cowboys -5.8 with a fair total of 50.6 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Dallas Cowboys pass offence vs Tampa Bay Buccaneers pass defence, which sits +0.238 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
